title: Derived restriction of scalars reflects isomorphisms
statement: For a constant coefficient ring map φ and every morphism f in the quotient-coefficient derived category, if adicDerivedRestrict X φ maps f to an isomorphism then f is an isomorphism.

proof.text: Restriction of scalars preserves finite limits and colimits and reflects isomorphisms on module sheaves. The induced derived functor is exact, so derived isomorphisms are detected degreewise on homology. The Lean proof installs the standard derived categories, reflects isomorphisms through the underlying sheaf functor, and applies DerivedCategory.isIso_iff to each homology map.

lean.statement: theorem adicDerivedRestrict_reflectsIsomorphisms (X : Scheme.{t}) {A B : Type t} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (φ : A →+* B) : ∀ {Y Z : proEtaleDerivedCategory X B} (f : Y ⟶ Z), IsIso ((adicDerivedRestrict (X := X) (A := A) (B := B) φ).map f) → IsIso f
